reasons.plausibility: HPT at 200°C on AlCoCrFeNi will cause rapid recovery/recrystallization, annihilating the intended dislocations and grain refinement, so the proposed strengthening mechanism is unlikely to persist at elevated temperatures.
reasons.testability: The test is clearly described (compare tensile properties of HPT vs. baseline at elevated temperatures) and the falsification criterion is explicit, though the test temperature is not specified.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is too generic and overlooks the known thermal instability of HPT-induced microstructures in this alloy class, making it a low-priority experiment for a researcher in the field.
